card.name: Inside warfarin and other drug names
card.fires_on: The middle or ending piece of a drug name, most often the "far" in warfarin, and the "acy" in the heading "Lack of Efficacy". It appears in drug interaction and warnings sections.

modes.label: Warfarin middle
modes.description: The "far" or "AR" piece inside the word warfarin, in interaction lists.
modes.example: 7.2 War<<far>>in Concomitant administration of multiple doses

modes.label: Other drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a longer generic drug name such as amlodipine or bexagliflozin.
modes.example: Consider discontinuation of olmesartan medoxomil, aml<<od>>ipine, and hydrochlorothiaz

modes.label: Efficacy heading
modes.description: The ending "acy" of Efficacy in the section title "Lack of Efficacy".
modes.example: 5.4 Lack of Effic<<acy>> in Patients with Decreased Hepatic Gly
